thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: 25% increase in 500s for /v1/generate in prod-us-east-1 over last 3m. Affected route: /chat/generic.

maria (oncall): seeing the alert. paging @kevin and @jessica.

kevin (svc-runtime): pulling logs now. any customer-reported errors?

carter (support): one early priority ticket: customer says 'responses are invalid JSON and suddenly embeddings endpoints started returning text'. looks like a mismatch. ticket id #3421.

jessica (sre): from traces: fallback policy is routing to variant "v2-embed-quant" but the original request was chat-instruct. stack shows "fallback_to_compatible=false" in policy.

omar (routing): wait we recently applied a routing rule that hardcodes model version to `ver-2026-07-01` for customer tier=enterprise in us-east. could that be the hardcoded version?

kevin (svc-runtime): confirming: the selection path: requested model family chat-instruct -> policy found pinned version `ver-2026-07-01` -> runtime attempted to use `ver-2026-07-01-embed` variant (incompatible) -> model runtime returns schema errors -> fallback kicked in and routed across regions -> introduced a fallback loop hitting us-west then back to us-east.

maria (oncall): good summary. customer impact: which customers? carter, can you list impacted orgs?

carter (support): impacted: acme-inc (high volume), beta-ml (medium), and ~12 smaller orgs. Acme reports 12% of requests failing, elevated latency.

emily (product): any recent pin/rollout that could cause cross-variant pinning?

omar (routing): I pushed a policy change earlier to enforce a stable version for enterprise: config snippet: ```json
{"policy":"enforce_version","version":"ver-2026-07-01"}``` I intended to pin chat models but the rule matches by model_family only; there was a naming collision where `ver-2026-07-01` includes both `chat` and `embed` variants.

jessica (sre): logs show 502/500 with message: "model schema mismatch: expected chat.tokens, received embedding.vector". sample log: ```[2026-08-03T14:05:12Z] req=0xabc status=500 err="schema mismatch" route=/chat/generic model=ver-2026-07-01-embed```

maria (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) disable the enforce_version policy for enterprise in us-east to stop hard routing 2) temporarily add a compatibility check in routing to reject variant-incompatible pins and fallback to nearest compatible model 3) notify customers and open RCA. Anyone oppose?

kevin (svc-runtime): we can flip the flag fast. command: `infractl routing update-policy --id enterprise-stable --enabled false --region us-east-1` will unpin.

omar (routing): doing it now. starting change.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: policy update started by omar at 2026-08-03T14:07:10Z.

omar (routing): done. confirmed policy disabled.

kevin (svc-runtime): I'm watching metrics. errors drop to 6% after 30s. KV cache priming issues remain for a bit.

jessica (sre): telemetry shows fallbacks reduced, but there are residual cross-region spikes as existing sessions chased pinned variants. will need session drain.

maria (oncall): next step: block the variant suffix matching in the compiler: add a safety check that rejects pinned versions whose variant doesn't match requested model type. Omar/kevin, can you add guard and a feature-flagged rollback?

kevin (svc-runtime): yes. small change: routing will compare requested_family vs pinned_variant_tag and if mismatch, respond with 409 to control plane and choose compatible candidate. putting behind `safety.reject_variant_mismatch` flag.

omar (routing): patch ready, deploying to canary in us-east-1a. command: ```deploy canary routing-service --flag safety.reject_variant_mismatch=true```

incident-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started at 2026-08-03T14:11:02Z.

carter (support): customers notified: sent short note to Acme and Beta-ML acknowledging degradation, mitigation in progress, ETA 15-30m.

kevin (svc-runtime): canary looks good, rejecting incompatible pins now. rolling to rest of us-east.

jessica (sre): Post-rollback monitor: errors back to baseline ~2% and latency back to SLO. no new customer reports in last 10m.

maria (oncall): good. action items: Omar to revert policy config and rework version naming to avoid variant collisions; Kevin to ship the safety flag permanently; Emily to draft customer postmortem; Jessica to collect traces and session churn metrics for RCA; Carter to follow up with impacted customers. We'll keep this open until RCA draft.

omar (routing): I'll file a PR for naming and policy validation and tag for review. PR: https://git.redwood/rl-routing/pull/448

emily (product): drafting postmortem and customer-facing summary now. will share in #product-updates.

maria (oncall): thanks everyone. closing incident channel when RCA link available. :thumbsup:
